text:
**Can I export my data from the app?**

Yes. Your financial data is yours, so you can take it with you. You can export your transactions as CSV or JSON. CSV files open in Excel, Google Sheets, or Numbers. JSON is the better choice if you want to bring your data into other apps or tools.

Exports are fast. An export of 10,000 transactions takes less than 2 minutes.

Exporting is also part of the free plan, so you don't need to upgrade to get your own records. It's useful if you're moving to a different budgeting tool, backing up your history, or looking at your spending in a spreadsheet.
